calls.title: Demandii & Growthbook LI Ads Chat
calls.summary: The discussion focused on the challenges of measuring LinkedIn content performance, with Ashley highlighting insufficient metrics, while Matthew noted 100,000 impressions year-to-date and issues with targeting. Current advertising efforts range from $5,000 to $10,000 monthly, primarily for awareness campaigns, but the conversion rate is low, necessitating a more targeted approach. Recent webinars have successfully generated strong attendance, and their recordings are accessible on YouTube for further engagement. The integration of LinkedIn with CRM tools remains partial, limiting visibility on conversions, and enhancement tools were proposed to improve this. Content quality is also under scrutiny, with calls for tailored messaging. Finally, next steps include sending a proposal to discuss program scopes and costs.
calls.keywords: LinkedIn Analytics, Lead Generation, Content Marketing, Account-Based Marketing, CRM Integration, Webinar Events
calls.action_items:
**Matthew Hunt**
Provide Ashley Stirrup with a clear proposal outlining services, strategy, and costs for switching to Demandii-managed LinkedIn ads and marketing program (29:48)
Send a scheduling link for Ashley to book a longer onboarding and strategic planning session with Demandii (30:05)
Follow up internally with the team to confirm the content success metrics and monthly/quarterly reporting processes to better communicate progress to clients (11:35)
Explore using AI agents to correlate LinkedIn analytics, ad data, and CRM inputs for clearer attribution and performance insights (09:15)
Recommend adopting tools like Fibbler and Demand Sense to integrate LinkedIn ads data with HubSpot for more robust pipeline influence tracking (08:20)
Advise on implementing sales team process changes to capture lead source attribution consistently during discovery calls (10:45)
Suggest improvements to webinar event execution including integrating Zoom with Restream for live streaming and replay promotion (28:00)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Review and consider internal definitions for measuring content and campaign success, and coordinate with Demandii on reporting needs (11:30)
Assess current advertising spend and campaign performance details to finalize transition plans (17:00)
Prepare questions and objectives for the upcoming onboarding meeting with Demandii (30:00)
